test_name: Verify User Login via Google OAuth
description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in using Google OAuth and is redirected to the dashboard after authentication.
steps: Locate the Google login button using its stable selector.
Verify redirection to the Google OAuth authentication page.
Click the 'Sign In' button on the Google authentication page.
Verify that the user is on the dashboard and logged in.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Google OAuth page.
User can authenticate using valid Google credentials.
User is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai.
User is logged into their dashboard successfully.
edge_cases: Google OAuth page fails to load.
User cancels the Google OAuth process.
data_requirements: Properly configured redirect URI for https://dev.roost.ai.
Valid client ID for Google OAuth.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be operational.
Redirection URI must be configured correctly.
User must have an active Google account.
api_interactions: Google OAuth API calls for authentication.
Roost backend API to validate authentication tokens.
performance_metrics: Time taken to authenticate and redirect back.
accessibility_requirements: Google OAuth page should support screen readers.
Login buttons should have ARIA labels for accessibility.
Ensure keyboard accessibility for all actions.
